title: Client Discovery Harness - Pricing Result
description: The hand-off to, and answer from, the separate pricing harness. This repository contains no pricing engine. pricing_payload must satisfy that harness's client_input.schema.json (required: schema_version, client_id, case_id, product, tax, fx, costs). commercial_context carries the sales context the pricing engine does not consume but the proposal does. Keeping the two apart is what lets both harnesses version independently - see ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.

pricing_payload.description: Validated against the pricing harness's own schema, not here. This schema does not restate a contract it does not own.

commercial_context.description: client, country, problem, buyer, value_proposition, competitive_advantage, competitor, channel, expected_quantity, commercial_conditions - consumed by the proposal, not by the pricing engine.

engine_result.description: The pricing harness's analysis_result, stored verbatim.
